review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: For height h above the highest point, the minimum radius is max(rho_i*h/(h-z_i)). Each point imposes a convex volume factor rho_i^2*h^3/(h-z_i)^2, minimized at3z_i; their maximum is convex and no optimum exceeds3max(z). Ternary search this domain, then recompute the enclosing radius and output height/radius to the required precision. Axis points impose only the minimum height; exclude their zero radial requirement from radius division, so a tip touching an axis point does not divide0/0.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
